question: You cannot see me, but you cannot live without me. Who am I?
I come down from the clouds. I help plants grow. Who am I?
I shine during the day and give light and warmth. Who am I?
I come out at night and sometimes look full and round. Who am I?
You drink me when you are thirsty. Who am I?
You sit on me at school. Who am I?
You wear me on your feet when you go outside. Who am I?
I have pages, but I am not a tree. You read me. Who am I?
I tell you what time it is. Who am I?
You use me to write with a pencil. Who am I?
I have keys but no locks. You can type on me. Who am I?
I am cold and white. People build snowmen from me. Who am I?
I bark, but I am not a tree. Who am I?
I have wings but I am not an airplane. I can fly. Who am I?
